visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a screen recording of a mobile MOBA game, featuring high-intensity combat between various sprites. Multi-colored skill effects, such as purple swirls and gold flashes, fill the frame along with fluctuating damage numbers. The digital environment is a lush green arena with stone paths. (2) A young woman with reddish-brown hair and a full fringe appears in a medium shot, smiling warmly. She is wearing a stylish black off-the-shoulder top. She holds a sleek, purple-colored smartphone with a unique textured back and a prominent square camera module. The setting is a cozy indoor studio with soft purple and orange ambient lighting and domestic decor. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the smartphone screen, showing a complex video editing interface. Hands with manicured nails are seen swiping and tapping on the screen, demonstrating smooth clip manipulation and transitions. Yellow stylized text overlays emphasize the speed and fluidity of the software. (4) The camera zooms in on the phone's back panel, specifically the circular speaker mesh which has water droplets resting on it. A gold 'VICTORY' graphic with decorative wings appears as a graphic overlay. The woman's face is partially visible as she holds the device, reacting with a joyful expression. (5) The woman is shown playing a game in landscape orientation, her thumbs moving with high agility. The scene cuts to her holding the phone while it is connected to a white charging cable. Information labels about 'Smart charging' and screen specifications appear as translucent overlays at the bottom of the frame. (6) Detailed shots highlight the phone's aesthetic design, including the intricate camera lenses and the silver-rimmed logo. The woman is seen in a different corner of the room near a kitchen counter with lemons. Finally, she holds the phone vertically, posing for the camera as a logo transition signals the end of the presentation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a deep male announcer voice from a game saying 'Our tower has been destroyed' accompanied by high-pitched magical chirps and the sharp clashing sounds of digital combat. There is no BGM in the first two seconds, creating an immersive gaming focus. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition into a high-energy Electronic Pop BGM with a consistent 4-on-the-floor beat and bright synth stabs. A female narrator enters with a clear, enthusiastic tone and a fast speech rate, describing the device's features. (3) A cinematic, reverberant 'VICTORY' voice-over rings out, marking a peak in the track's loudness and arousal. This is layered with the subtle, percussive sound of water vibrating against the phone's surface, mimicking high-fidelity bass impact. (4) Frequent digital 'ding' and 'pop' SFX underscore various text features appearing on screen. The BGM remains steady in the background. The narrator's speech is dense, maintaining a positive valence and professional broadcast clarity throughout the breakdown of tech specs. (5) The BGM swells slightly for the final branding slogan, concluding with a clean digital logo chime. The female voice maintains its high pitch and confident delivery until the final second, ensuring a high-impact promotional finish.
